name: io.github.rayhankhilji/localcloud
title: localcloud
description: Share localhost dev servers at public HTTPS URLs — built for cloud coding agents.

packageArguments.description: Run localcloud as an MCP server

environmentVariables.name: LOCALCLOUD_RELAY
environmentVariables.description: URL of the localcloud relay to connect to, e.g. https://relay.example.com (optional if the project commits a localcloud.json)

environmentVariables.name: LOCALCLOUD_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Access token, if the relay requires one
